assessment: No correctness blocker found in source review. Performance acceptance remains gated on root measurements.
independent_review_scope: Original-to-async-load production diff, cache result wrappers, coroutine macros, retry/callback ownership. Reviewer prepared the targeted variant; this is a separate pass, not an independent author.
checks: Lookup alignment and capacity checks keep their original order and precede directory indexing. Cold helper only reformats the same rejection diagnostics; UNLIKELY does not remove checks.
Sync get allocation validation remains inline and before both disk admission and nonblocking STATUS_BUSY; no helper/handle escape remains.
Only caller of static clockcache_get_from_disk_async is existing parent async subroutine. Parent first validates lookup geometry and sets tid/entry_number.
Moved allocation check executes after child async_begin and before entry reservation, read-reference acquisition, I/O state initialization or callback registration.

Invalid fresh miss sets result_status BAD_PARAM and succeeded TRUE; child returns DONE, parent returns DONE, top-level retry loop exits with unchanged NULL __async_result. API result wrapper clears caller handle. No callback is invoked.
Admission race returns succeeded FALSE without a page/ref; outer retry resets both subroutine levels and repeats lookup plus miss allocation validation.

I/O-resumption jumps to the existing async_await continuation, bypassing allocation check/reservation/setup. This matches original caller-level check behavior on suspension; callers must keep extent allocated throughout.
Read setup/append/completion failures and successful callback/load publication retain exactly the existing cleanup, read-reference, status and succeeded logic.
No change to coroutine stack depth, state layout, callback arguments, I/O ownership or caller-owned handle lifetime.
